_comment: Azure Blob Storage lifecycle management policy for the processed-orders container.
_usage: Apply via: az storage account management-policy create --account-name YOUR_ACCOUNT --policy @docs/blob-lifecycle-policy.json
_local_note: Azurite does not enforce lifecycle policies — this JSON defines the production rule.

rules.name: tier-processed-orders-cool
rules._comment: Move blobs to Cool tier after 30 days. Cool = lower storage cost, slightly higher access cost.
rules._cost_note: Cool tier: ~50% of Hot tier storage cost. 30-day minimum retention. Ideal for blobs accessed < once per month.

rules.name: tier-old-months-to-archive
rules._comment: Move blobs older than 365 days to Archive tier. Archive = lowest cost, retrieval takes hours.
rules._cost_note: Archive tier: ~80% of Cool tier storage cost. Retrieval requires rehydration (Standard: 1-15 hours, High: 1 hour). Use for compliance data not expected to be accessed.

rules.name: delete-ancient-orders
rules._comment: Delete blobs older than 2555 days (~7 years). Adjust to match your data retention policy.
rules._legal_note: Check your jurisdiction's financial record retention requirements before reducing below 7 years.

rules.name: delete-old-checkpoints
rules._comment: Event Hubs checkpoint blobs (Post 13) older than 7 days are stale.
rules._rationale: EventProcessorClient rewrites checkpoints on every processed event. A checkpoint blob older than 7 days indicates a partition that has had no events — safe to clean up.
